purpose: Obtain immutable official distribution and executable identity before future Actions admission; no browser or benchmark execution

prospective_behavior: HEAD then at most one bounded GET of the exact official URL; missing/oversized Content-Length or unapproved redirect stops
Stream archive into a new private nonexecutable file and compute SHA256; no install command, subprocess, browser, Node, native import or model
Inspect ZIP central-directory bounds and safe member names; stream-hash executable and immutable distribution members without extracting or executing them
Retain only private archive plus public-eligible bounded scalar identities; never include the binary in source/public artifacts
A failure stops for review without retry or substituting another browser version
scientific_identity_scope: Official distribution contents and loaded runtime helper bytes; same allocated job OS/CPU/ISA observed and carried. Do not demand byte-identical system dependency or whole OS trees across jobs.
